title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy — Hazardous-Material Survey Fee on Reversed Water Losses
content:
**Fee.** A hazardous-material survey fee is added because the wet walls, floors or ceilings of every reversed water loss are cut out, by the year the dwelling was built: 750.00 for a dwelling built before 1978, 350.00 for one built from 1978 through 1989, and nothing for one built in 1990 or later.

This fee applies to the dwelling water damage of a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy claim settled in place of a repeated-seepage denial. It is a flat dollar amount, added to the reversal payment on the dwelling water damage before the floor at 0.00 and the single rounding to the cent. The year built is the one on the policy's declarations.

| Year built | Survey fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| 1977 or earlier | 750.00 |
| 1978 through 1989 | 350.00 |
| 1990 or later | none |

**Years at the edges.**
- 1977: 750.00. 1978: 350.00.
- 1989: 350.00. 1990: no fee.

The fee does not vary with the size of the loss: a hypothetical dwelling built in 1972 takes 750.00 whether its water damage is valued at 3000.00 or at 30000.00.
